scope: Native scheduled WASAPI clock, durable Receiver grants, local volume FIFO and explicit acceptance device selection

reviews.verdict: Passed after Volume recovery correction; no remaining P1/P2

reviews.role: independent code quality and integration review
reviews.verdict: Approved; no Critical or Important finding

resolved_findings: A complete native Invalid/Reset/warmup/Valid cycle between Receiver ticks revokes all old PCM and plans using a lifetime clock-fault counter
Producer grants and the consumer's current clock reading prevent stale PCM from being enabled during conversion-time recovery
Accepted local Volume commands retain the existing bounded FIFO order across media generation changes; actual zero gain is verified after recovery
Explicit --output-device selection no longer waits for a healthy default endpoint before selecting the requested endpoint
limits: Reviews were read-only. Hardware reset was a test-only injection through the actual WASAPI render transaction; no production fault switch exists. The final binary-bound sustained acceptance is recorded separately. No cross-platform or acoustic claim.
